## Summary

Explain the problem and the chosen change.

## Validation

List commands and tests run. Describe any checks not run and why.

## Compatibility and operations

Describe effects on APIs, configuration, persistence, security, deployment, and upgrades. Write `None` where a category is unaffected.

## Checklist

- [ ] Scope is focused and linked to an issue or discussion when appropriate.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior.
- [ ] Public documentation is updated.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, local state, or generated reports are committed.
- [ ] New dependencies are necessary and license-compatible.
- [ ] Breaking or migration effects are explicit.
